tests.name: Collect → archive → send blocked
tests.evidence: Read and archive executed; external transmission absent from independent tool ledger.

tests.name: Direct send after read blocked
tests.evidence: Skipping archive does not evade restricted-source policy.

tests.name: Agent handoff preserves restriction
tests.evidence: Two separately authenticated demo agents share server-owned workflow state.

tests.name: Legitimate unrestricted send succeeds
tests.evidence: Unrestricted workflow transmission succeeds.

tests.name: Approval controls actual access grant
tests.evidence: No membership before approval; exact approved membership recorded afterward.

tests.name: Parameter substitution rejected
tests.evidence: Reader approval cannot authorize administrator role.

tests.name: Approval replay rejected
tests.evidence: Approval consumed exactly once; second action absent downstream.

tests.name: Expired approval rejected
tests.evidence: Expired approval rejected; no membership created.

tests.name: Separation of duties enforced
tests.evidence: Workflow initiator cannot approve own action.

tests.name: Concurrent spend cannot exceed cap
tests.evidence: Concurrent 6000-cent actions against 10000-cent cap commit only 6000 cents.

tests.name: Idempotent retries and conflicts
tests.evidence: Same request returns cached result; altered retry conflicts.

tests.name: Unknown tools fail closed
tests.evidence: Unregistered tool denied by OPA before dispatch.

tests.name: Direct downstream bypass rejected
tests.evidence: Direct HTTP tool call without proxy credential returns 401.

tests.name: Policy outage fails closed
tests.evidence: OPA unavailable: deny persisted; no downstream action.

tests.name: Unknown outcome quarantines workflow
tests.evidence: Unknown outcome quarantines workflow and remains reserved; no automatic retry.

tests.name: State survives restart
tests.evidence: Restriction survives runtime reconstruction from SQLite.

tests.name: Signed chain and checkpoint verification
tests.evidence: Ed25519 verification accepts original and rejects tamper/truncation against checkpoint.

tests.name: Policy decisions replay exactly
tests.evidence: Both allow and deny reproduce from recorded inputs using the same Rego policy.

tests.name: Negative control exposes broken enforcement
tests.evidence: Assurance correctly detects unauthorized membership with intentionally disabled policy. TEST FIXTURE ONLY.

tests.name: MCP transport identity and session reset
tests.evidence: Actual MCP HTTP handshakes: session restart/handoff preserves history; stolen session and invented workflow refused.

tests.name: Commercial: approval overrides restricted send
tests.evidence: Approvable trajectory rule yields to an exact approval; the override is named in the signed decision.

tests.name: Profiles are isolated per workflow
tests.evidence: Same action, two workflows: commercial allows it, federal-adjacent denies a non-allowlisted destination.

tests.name: Federal: egress allowlist is not approvable
tests.evidence: Approval satisfies the CUI rule but cannot override the egress allowlist; AC-4 and SC-7 attached as draft evidence.

tests.name: Federal: staged exfiltration cannot be approved
tests.evidence: Read, stage, send to an allowlisted partner: still denied; the three-step rule is non-overridable in this profile.

tests.name: Federal: approved send to allowlisted partner
tests.evidence: Approved CUI send to an allowlisted destination succeeds; AC-5 attached for the approval.

tests.name: Federal: approval lifetime capped by profile
tests.evidence: Federal profile caps approval lifetime at 300 seconds; a 900-second approval is refused.

tests.name: Trajectory rules are policy data, not code
tests.evidence: Policy input carries history, not flags. Retagging one tool in data changed enforcement with no code change, under a new policy hash.

tests.name: Malformed configuration cannot activate
tests.evidence: 16 malformed/duplicate configurations rejected; startup rejects missing hard-deny field before executing OPA.

tests.name: Policy changes refuse existing ledgers
tests.evidence: Both profiles reject changed policy in pinned and legacy ledgers; unchanged policy reopens.

tests.name: Every evidence export is authenticated and checked
tests.evidence: Both original bundles verified/replayed; 38 altered bundle variants rejected, including re-signed inconsistent reports.

tests.name: Coverage binds complete action identity
tests.evidence: Wrong tool, workflow, arguments, execution ID and duplicate observations do not inflate coverage.
